source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Μαΐου — «Όσιοι Μάμας, Παχώμιος και Ιλαρίων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives him his own head line beside Mamas and Pachomius; the couplet names all three, «Ἰλαρίωνι καὶ Παχωμίω Μάμας, / Συνεξεδήμει τὴν καλὴν ἐκδημίαν». That is a company the page enumerates, three head lines and three names, so it is three folders, of which the other two are upgrades on `mamas-6-may` and `pachomius-6-may`. **This is not `hilarion-4-may`, and the reason is on both calendars.** doxologia prints a bare «Sfântul Cuvios Ilarion» twice, on 4 mai and again on 6 mai, on two separate pages; the Romanian pass made a folder from the 4 mai line only. saint.gr likewise prints two: «Όσιος Ιλάριος ο Θαυματουργός» on 4 Μαΐου, whose name is Ιλάριος and not Ιλαρίων, and this Ιλαρίων on 6 Μαΐου in a named company of three. Two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so two men, and the 6 Μαΐου man is the one the trio holds. **If a later reader decides the two are one, this is the newer folder and the one to fold away.** No year, no place, no hymn: the page says only that the three lived in a desert place in fasting, vigils and good works, in concord of soul, and fell asleep in peace.
